title: Jeff Nippard Body Building Transformation System
author: nelson mancia

ex.note:
1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the
pecs

Do one set with low cable position, one set with medium-height cable
position, and one height with a high cable position.

Once you are under the bar, set up your feet as you would a normal squat
and then bring them forward ~3-6 inches. This will cause you to lean back
into the bar slightly, allowing for an upright squat

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus
on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep.
